answer: The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in gale, expire in knoll, and river lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 189 aliases as a result needs 55 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2122 identities would post 1295 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
